description: This course explores the intersections of science and culture in Japan. Students gain field
research experience while examining the unique ecosystems of the Kii Peninsula, a UNESCO World
Heritage Site home to numerous endemic species of flora and fauna, including waterfall-climbing
fish and giant salamander. The course also introduces cultural perspectives and ethical issues
related to the life sciences. Offered periodically during January term. Prerequisite: BIO 150 -
fullname: Exploring Science and Culture in Japan: Kii Peninsula (study abroad)
